summary: Comprehensive testing of No Limit Delivery food delivery app. Backend: 17/17 tests passing (100%). Frontend: Core features working but login navigation bug found.

minor.fix_applied: Added $project stage to exclude _id from aggregation pipeline

integration_issues.issue: Login button click does not navigate to home screen after successful authentication. API call succeeds (verified via backend tests), but router.replace('/(tabs)/home') is not executing. User can access home screen directly via URL.
integration_issues.workaround: Users can navigate directly to /home after login

issues: Missing testID attributes on email input, password input, and Sign In button - makes automated testing difficult
Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow' instead (React Native Web deprecation)

action_items: Fix login navigation: Investigate why router.replace() is not working in /app/frontend/app/auth/login.tsx after successful API call
Add testID attributes to login form elements for better test coverage
Update shadow* style props to boxShadow across all components to remove deprecation warnings
critical_code_review_comments: MongoDB ObjectId Handling: Fixed in /api/ai/randomizer by excluding _id field. Should verify all other endpoints also exclude _id (restaurants, menu, orders endpoints already handle this correctly)
Login Component: The handleLogin function appears correct but router.replace() is not navigating. May be related to Expo Router configuration or async timing issue
Missing testID attributes: Login screen and several other components lack testID props which are critical for React Native testing

success_rate.frontend: 85% (Login navigation broken, all other features working: home screen, restaurant detail, menu, add to cart, cart screen, checkout button, tab navigation)

seed_data_creation: Database already seeded with 15 restaurants and menu items. Test user test@demo.com exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully functional. Frontend loads and most features work correctly. The critical bug is in the login flow - the Sign In button does not navigate to home screen despite successful authentication. All other navigation (tabs, restaurant detail, cart) works perfectly. The app can be tested by navigating directly to /home.

backend: ✓ Authentication error handling (401 for invalid/missing tokens)
frontend: ✓ Login screen renders with email/password fields and Google login button
✗ Login with test@demo.com / test123 does NOT navigate to home (BUG)
✓ Home screen accessible directly - shows featured restaurants with images
✓ Restaurant detail shows menu items with Add to Cart buttons
✓ Cart screen shows added items with quantity controls (+/- buttons)
✓ Cart shows correct calculations (subtotal, delivery fee, tax, total)
✓ Checkout button present with total amount
✓ Tab navigation works (Home, Search, Orders, Profile)
✓ Search tab shows restaurant list with filters
✓ Profile tab shows 'Not logged in' state (expected since login navigation broken)

test_execution_summary.backend_tests: Executed 17 pytest test cases covering auth, restaurants, menu, orders, and AI features. All tests passed after fixing MongoDB ObjectId serialization issue in AI randomizer endpoint.
test_execution_summary.frontend_tests: Executed Playwright browser automation tests covering onboarding, login, home screen, restaurant detail, menu browsing, cart operations, and tab navigation. All features work except login navigation.
